pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly shaped dark regions with rounded vertices and smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Individual patches display a high relative spatial area with a lack of sharp geometric angularity.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous, interconnected network of light-colored corridors. Junction nodes are clearly visible where three or four patches meet. Corridor pixel thickness is variable, narrowing significantly where adjacent patches converge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A fine-grained, high-frequency serrated silhouette is visible along the dorsal line of the neck, corresponding to the terminal edge of the mane.
